outcome.Summary: Implemented words.TopK in words/words.go: streams the input through a 1 MB bufio buffer in fixed chunks, tokenizing runes (with incomplete-tail handling for runes split across chunks) as maximal runs of Unicode letters/digits with internal apostrophes only between letters, case-folds with strings.ToLower, filters case-insensitive stop words, counts in a map, then sorts by count descending / word ascending and truncates to k (k <= 0 → non-nil empty slice), returning any read error. Verified with a temporary test suite covering apostrophe edge cases, unicode, stops, tie order, large single-line input with boundary-straddling runes, very long tokens, and injected read errors; all passed, then removed the temp tests. go build, go vet, and go test ./... all exit 0.
